privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.legalNotice: Note: this text is a first draft written for the MVP launch and has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer. Before public launch, it should be validated by Casa da Cidade's leadership and, ideally, by legal counsel.
privacy.intro: This page explains, in plain language, what data the Precisa-se platform collects, why it collects it, and what rights you have over it.

whatWeCollect.heading: What data we collect
whatWeCollect.body: When you create an account, we store your name, email, password (never in plain text — it is always encrypted) and, if you choose to share it, your phone number and your community or church affiliation. When you publish a request or an offer, we store the title, description, category, and the contact you choose to share (phone, WhatsApp, or email).

why.heading: Why we collect this data
why.body: We use this data exclusively to connect requests and offers within the Casa da Cidade community — for example, so someone interested in your volunteering request can reach you. We do not use your data for advertising or any other purpose.

protection.heading: How we protect your contact details
protection.body: The contact details attached to a post (phone, WhatsApp, or email) are encrypted before being stored in the database — even if someone had direct access to the database, they could not read your contact without the separately stored encryption key. Passwords are protected with an industry-standard algorithm (argon2id), never stored in plain text.

sharing.heading: Sharing with third parties
sharing.body: We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your contact is only revealed to another user when they express explicit interest in one of your posts — and only to that person, never publicly.

retention.heading: How long we keep your data
retention.body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. Audit records (for example, the record that you requested account deletion) are kept for a limited period after deletion for accountability reasons — currently planned at 12 months, a figure that may be adjusted with legal advice.

deletion.heading: Your right to delete your data
deletion.body: You can request deletion of your account at any time from the "My account" page. When you confirm with your current password, your name, email, phone, and affiliation are immediately anonymized and the account can no longer be used to sign in. Posts you published are no longer linked to your identity, but may remain visible to preserve the community's history.

contact.heading: Privacy questions
contact.body: If you have any questions about this policy or your data, contact the Casa da Cidade office. (Note: this is a placeholder contact point — before launch, it should be replaced with a real email address or privacy contact.)
